title: Office Administrator
description:
Office Administrator

Location: Uddingston, Glasgow

Salary: 27,500 - 30,000

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm

Job Type: Permanent

Are you an organised and proactive administrator looking for a varied role within a friendly and supportive team? We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and successful business seeking an Office Administrator to support the smooth day-to-day running of its operations.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a company that offers a fun working environment, a positive culture, and genuine long-term career prospects.

The Role:

As an Office Administrator, you'll play a key part in supporting office operations, transport administration, and, with training provided, the hire desk when required. This is a varied position where no two days are the same, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working in a busy environment and thrives on organisation.

Key Responsibilities:
- Raising and processing purchase orders.
- Maintaining accurate records, files, and operational documentation.
- Supporting invoicing processes and liaising with the accounts team.
- Handling incoming telephone calls, emails, and general office enquiries.
- Assisting with reporting, data entry, and general administration.
- Monitoring and updating transport schedules and operational records.
- Supporting compliance administration and maintaining accurate documentation.
- Providing cover for the hire desk when required (full training provided).
- Taking customer enquiries and processing crane hire bookings.
- Preparing hire documentation and delivering excellent customer service.

About You:

We're looking for someone who has:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within transport, logistics, construction, or a similar industry.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a team-focused approach.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary of 27,500 - 33,000, depending on experience.
- Monday to Friday working hours - 8:00am to 4:30pm.
- Friendly, supportive, and fun working environment.
- Positive company culture where employees are valued.
- Full training provided for hire desk responsibilities.
- Opportunity to develop your skills and build a long-term career.

If you're looking for a varied administration role with a growing business that values teamwork and offers excellent career stability, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or email (url removed) if you are interested in this opportunity.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
Data & Administration Coordinator

Salary: 25,500 per annum Full-time 37.5 hours per week

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Data & Administration Coordinator to join our team and provide administrative support across two busy teams.

This is a varied role, ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, is confident using Excel and can manage a high volume of work accurately and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:
- Completing accurate data entry and maintaining records.
- Entering timesheets into timesheet system.
- Completing portal entries and ensuring information is kept up to date.
- Running and reconciling reports, investigating and resolving discrepancies where required.
- Checking and approving portal shifts.
- Raising invoices accurately and within required timescales.
- Providing general administrative support across both teams.
- Supporting with ad-hoc tasks as required.

We are looking for someone who:
- Has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in producing accurate work.
- Is confident using Excel and working with data.
- Can manage large volumes of information without losing accuracy.
- Is organised and able to prioritise competing deadlines.
- Can work at a fast pace and remain calm under pressure.
- Has a proactive and flexible approach.
- Is happy to support across different areas of the business.
- Has good communication skills and enjoys working as part of a team.

Previous experience in an administrative, data entry, finance or similar role would be advantageous, but the right attitude, accuracy and willingness to learn are just as important.

The weekly hours would be 37.5 but the client can be flexible with start and end times, the start of the week is the busiest so they could do long days for an earlier finish on a Friday or even some Sunday hours if the successful candidate would like (not essential though).

If this sounds like an opportunity you would be interested in, then please apply now or email me on (url removed)
